random_evaluation: Date-grouped exploratory 70/15/15. Candidate selection by validation macro-F1 then validation balanced accuracy. Selected model refit on train+validation and evaluated on held-out test.
chronological_evaluation: Separate temporal diagnostic using weather-baseline Dummy and Random Forest; no model selection from chronological validation.
target_limitation: water_stress_rule_derived is produced by the simulation and is not independent field-observed ground truth.
intervention_feature_limitation: Irrigation litres are day-t simulated intervention. In the model-triggered scenario this feature is calculated from simulated depletion and is mechanistically coupled to the target.
permutation_importance: Computed on validation data, not held-out test data.
